name: Warsaw Stock Exchange
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars only (backfill; not independently verified). 2025-2028: exchange_calendars + exchange_publications (GPW Management Board resolutions on non-session days). 2029: predicted from exchange_calendars and the exchange's unchanged pattern; GPW has not yet resolved it. Rechecked 2026-11-20 (4c-R4). Non-session days: Resolution 754/2025 of 12 June 2025 (https://www.gpw.pl/pub/GPW/uchwaly/2025/754_2025.pdf) lists 2027 (Jan 1, Jan 6, Mar 26, Mar 29, May 3, May 27, Nov 1, Nov 11, Dec 24, Dec 31) and Resolution 1089/2026 of 20 July 2026 (https://www.gpw.pl/pub/GPW/uchwaly/2026/1089_2026_EN.pdf) lists 2028 (Jan 6, Apr 14, Apr 17, May 1, May 3, Jun 15, Aug 15, Nov 1, Dec 25, Dec 26); the registry matches both exactly, and the 2027 and 2028 entries now cite those resolutions. 2026 was not re-read: Resolution 753/2025 (2026) could not be retrieved in this session. Close (ADR 0013): GPW WATS went live on 5 October 2026 (Resolution 941/2026, https://www.gpw.pl/pub/GPW/uchwaly/2026/941_2026_EN.pdf). The WATS Detailed Exchange Trading Rules (https://www.gpw.pl/pub/GPW/files/PDF/regulacje/SZOG_GPW_WATS_en.pdf), Division IV, Chapter 3, Section 1, schedule the continuous trading system as opening auction 08:30-09:00, continuous trading 09:00-16:50, closing auction 16:50-17:00 (including determination of the closing price) and trading at last 17:00-17:05; under WATS the scheduled times are the earliest and latest times of each phase including the random-end parameter (Resolution 1252/2025). regular_hours.close 17:00 is therefore the end of the closing auction from 2026-10-05; WATS did not change the share schedule. 2013-04-15 to 2026-10-02 (UTP): the same 16:50-17:00 closing auction is reported in republished GPW announcements, but GPW's own UTP rules text was not read. Before 2013-04-15 (Warset) the registry's 17:00 is unconfirmed: GPW Resolution 933/2010 (from 3 January 2011) is reported to set a 17:20-17:30 closing call, but the resolution itself was not found on gpw.pl, so the close was not changed. Half days: none. The WATS schedule has no shortened-session provision and the 2027 and 2028 resolutions list only full non-session days (Dec 24 and Dec 31 are closures). No Saturday sessions. One-off closure: 2013-04-16 (day after the UTP migration) is closed, from exchange_calendars. The GPW fetcher cannot reach gpw.pl from this sandbox; the sources were read by hand.
